items.question: Are the courses available online?
items.answer: Selected programmes can be offered online. Please check the individual course page or contact our admission team for current availability.

items.question: Can working teachers join?
items.answer: Yes, eligible working teachers can apply. Our flexible online and hybrid modes are designed to accommodate professional schedules.

items.question: Can homemakers join?
items.answer: Yes, eligible homemakers can apply. Many of our learners are parents and homemakers pursuing a meaningful career in education.

items.question: Will I receive a certificate?
items.answer: Learners who successfully complete the applicable programme requirements will receive the corresponding course certificate with affiliation details.

items.question: Can I apply for a job after completing a course?
items.answer: The course can support relevant job applications, but employment depends on the learner's qualifications and the requirements of each school or employer.

items.question: What documents are required for admission?
items.answer: Typically ID proof, educational certificates and a passport-size photograph. Our team will guide you through the complete list during application.

items.question: What is the course fee?
items.answer: Fees vary by programme. Contact us at 7708743942 or Spedicsmont@gmail.com for the latest fee structure and instalment options.
